ds.title: Design system
ds.description: Tokens, typography, shape and brand of the Re-Teck template. The reference for prototyping screens.
ds.phaseNote: Foundation (phase 1) and components (phase 3). Page patterns arrive in phase 5.
ds.contrastNote: Every text/background pair passes WCAG 2.2 AA (npm run check:contrast).

colorRule.lead: Color follows meaning, not taste. One color, one meaning, across the whole system.
rules: Brand color is not a state color: brand green and lime stay in the logo, login, empty states and the line under the navbar.
Primary button = petrol blue. Secondary = neutral (outline). Dangerous = red. Green only when confirming a success (Approve, Complete).
Color is never the only signal: every status has text and an icon.
Notice background = light tint (~10%) with text and border in the strong tone.
Yellow is never text on a light background: text uses darkened amber.
Category charts use their own palette; state colors only when the chart means good/attention/bad.
colorRule.alertBody: 12 items are below minimum stock. Restock before month-end closing.

palette.lead: OKLCH 50–950 scales generated from the logo (npm run tokens). ★ = exact logo value. Components use semantic tokens, never the palette directly.

charts.lead: Category series use their own palette, derived from the brand and neutrals — no state colors.

typography.lead: Inter Variable for the interface (14px base), JetBrains Mono for codes, IDs and serials, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese.
typography.numbersLead: Values and tables use tabular figures and slashed zero (num class).
typography.cjkLead: Noto Sans TC loads only when the language is 繁體中文.

shape.shadowsLead: In dark theme, shadows become a border and a lighter surface.

density.lead: Comfortable (default) or compact: changes the height of fields, buttons and table rows.

brand.lead: Full logo in the navbar (light variant in dark theme), globe only on narrow screens. Icons generated from the globe (npm run brand).
brand.gradient: Brand gradient (line under the navbar, login, empty state)

c.statusLead: Every status comes from the statusMap: tone (color by meaning) + icon + label. The flow order is used to sort tables.
c.buttonsLead: Teal primary (one main action per area), neutral secondary, red for danger and green only to confirm success. Heights follow density.
c.withIcons: With icon and icon-only (always with an accessible label)
c.focusHint: Hover to see the hover state and press Tab to see focus (2px teal outline).
c.badgesLead: Neutral counter for pending items; red only when the number is about errors. Tags are free labels, not statuses.
c.fieldsLead: Every field has a label, required indicator, help text, an error linked to the field (aria-describedby) and a counter when there's a limit. Leave a masked field to validate it.

f.name: Name
f.periodHelp: The "to" date includes the whole day.

c.formLead: React Hook Form + Zod: validates on blur and on submit; messages in 3 languages. Try submitting it empty.

c.metadataLead: Key-value block (empty becomes "—"), copyable ID in monospace, relative date with full date in the tooltip, and created/updated by.

c.navigationLead: Tabs, breadcrumb, steps (wizard), pagination and tree — all keyboard accessible.
c.menusLead: Avatar with initials, tooltip, popover, actions menu (⋯) and context menu (right click or Menu key).
c.activityLead: Audit timeline (who, when, what, before → after), comments and attachments with upload.
c.feedbackLead: Toasts for quick confirmations, inline alerts, page banner, empty states, skeleton, spinner and progress — always with icon and text.
